newsitem.title: UK: Suez Cement says GDR issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Suez Cement says GDR issue oversubscribed.

text.p: Suez Cement Co said on Thursday the price of its global depositary receipt issue had been more than five times oversubscribed.
The seven million GDR issue was priced at $14.75, the equivalent of 50 Egyptian pounds, a share and will be listed on the London Stock Exchange on December 3.
The price represented a 1.69 percent discount to the average share price between November 10-24.
About 61 percent of the demand came from UK and other European institutions and 32 percent from the U.S..
The global coordinator, Salomon Brothers International Ltd, has been granted an over-allotment option to buy an additional 750,000 GDRs.
Assuming exercise of the option, the issue will raise $114 million for its five selling shareholders.
